name: Chinon Apple Tarts
assumptions: Recipe makes 2 individual tarts based on cutting 2 x 13cm circles from one 320g puff pastry sheet.
Total active and passive preparation/cooking time estimated from instructions: ~20 min jelly (including boil), 10 min pastry temper, 5 min grill, 25 min bake, plus minor prep steps.
Puff pastry contains wheat (standard unless specified gluten-free).
No eggs, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, peanuts, soy, or sesame listed or implied.
Cardamom listed as 3 (pods assumed); no impact on classifications.
Red wine jelly ingredients (including jam sugar) introduce no additional allergens or diet conflicts beyond those noted.
All ingredients screened as listed; no unlisted compound items assumed.
instructions:
To make the red wine jelly, put the red wine, jam sugar, star anise, clove, cinnamon stick, allspice, split vanilla pod and seeds in a medium saucepan. Stir together, then heat gently to dissolve the sugar. Turn up the heat and boil for 20 mins until reduced and syrupy. Strain into a small, sterilised jam jar and leave to cool completely. Will keep in the fridge for up to 1 month.

Take the pastry out of the fridge and leave at room temperature for 10 mins, then unroll. Heat the grill to high and heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Cut out 2 x 13cm circles of pastry, using a plate as a guide, and place on a non-stick baking sheet. Sprinkle each circle with 1 tbsp sugar and grill for 5 mins to caramelise, watching carefully so that the sugar doesn’t burn. Remove from the grill. Can be done a few hours ahead, and left, covered, out of the fridge.

Peel, quarter and core the apples, cut into 2mm-thin slices and arrange on top of the pastry. Sprinkle over the remaining sugar and pop in the oven for 20-25 mins until the pastry is cooked through and golden, and the apples are softened. Remove and allow to cool slightly. Warm 3 tbsp of the red wine jelly in a small pan over a low heat with 1 tsp water to make it a little more runny, then brush over the top of the tarts.

Tip the crème fraîche into a bowl, sift over the icing sugar and cardamom, and mix together. Carefully lift the warm tarts onto serving plates and serve with the cardamom crème fraîche.

ingredients.name: Puff Pastry
ingredients.assumptions: Standard all-butter puff pastry; values for uncooked sheet as listed.

ingredients.name: Dark Brown Soft Sugar
ingredients.assumptions: Dark brown soft sugar; 1 tbsp ≈ 13 g, total 4 tbsp used across recipe.

ingredients.name: Braeburn Apples
ingredients.assumptions: Medium Braeburn apples; average whole edible weight after peel/core ≈ 150 g each, total for 3 apples.

ingredients.name: Red Wine Jelly
ingredients.assumptions: Red wine jelly made earlier in recipe; 1 tbsp ≈ 20 g, using 4 tbsp total for glazing.

ingredients.name: Creme Fraiche
ingredients.assumptions: Full-fat crème fraîche; 100 ml ≈ 98 g density.

ingredients.name: Cardamom
ingredients.assumptions: Ground cardamom pods/seeds; 3 pods yield ≈ 2 g seeds but scaled to typical 6 g total measurable amount for sifting into crème.
